descriptions.w3d_d27a_motion_step_trace_8001b964: While the step vector at 0x8041e850 is longer than the limit (squared), traces the motion at 0x8041e780 up to 10000 units. If nothing is hit, calls 0x80118a5c with the height and the last goal. If something is hit, copies the hit point 0x8043ae20 to the goal 0x8041e85c, advances with 0x800d76dc using the hit time and dispatches the normal with 0x8001baf4.
